speaker: Doctor
text: The patient is a 31-week, 1100-g preterm infant born three days ago with a history of chorioamnionitis, low Apgar scores, and recent onset of seizures and lethargy. Given the history of intra-amniotic infection and prematurity, do you have any information regarding blood glucose levels or signs of respiratory distress?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Sepsis complicated by Intraventricular Hemorrhage (IVH).

The clinical picture of a preterm infant with chorioamnionitis, seizures, and lethargy, combined with the ultrasound confirmation of ventricular bleeding, strongly supports this diagnosis. Pending the results of your blood cultures to identify the specific pathogen, I will initiate broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy and neuroprotective measures immediately.
